import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def cells(g,v):
    return [(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==v]
for n in [1,2,3,4]:
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    c4=cells(gi,4); c6=cells(gi,6); co4=cells(go,4); co6=cells(go,6)
    print(n,'in4rows',[i for i,_ in c4],'in6rows',[i for i,_ in c6])
    print('   out4rows',[i for i,_ in co4],'out6rows',[i for i,_ in co6])
    rows6=[i for i,_ in c6]; rows4=[i for i,_ in c4]
    # relation between 6-obj columns and 4 bbox
    mc=min(c[0]+c[1] for c in c6)/2; ac=min(i+j for i,j in c6)
    print('   six top row',min(rows6),'six col',mc,'four rows',min(rows4),max(rows4))

import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for n in range(1,5):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    def mk(g,v): return [(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==v]
    c4=mk(gi,4); c6=mk(gi,6); o4=mk(go,4)
    rs4=[i for i,_ in c4]; cs4=[j for _,j in c4]
    rs6=[i for i,_ in c6]; cs6=[j for _,j in c6]
    # added cells rel to orig bbox
    aabs=sorted(set(o4)-set(c4))
    rmin=min(i for i,_ in aabs); rmax=max(i for i,_ in aabs); cmin=min(j for _,j in aabs); cmax=max(j for _,j in aabs)
    print(f'demo{n}: 4bbox rows{min(rs4)}-{max(rs4)} cols{min(cs4)}-{max(cs4)} | 6bbox rows{min(rs6)}-{max(rs6)} cols{min(cs6)}-{max(cs6)}')
    print('   added bbox rows',rmin,'-',rmax,'cols',cmin,'-',cmax)
    # check symmetry of combined 4-mask
    O=[[0]*len(go[0]) for _ in go]; 
    for i,j in o4: O[i][j]=1
    H=len(O); W=len(O[0])
    vs=all(O[i][j]==O[H-1-i][j] for i in range(H) for j in range(W))
    hs=all(O[i][j]==O[i][W-1-j] for i in range(H) for j in range(W))
    print('   combined symmetric v:',vs,' h:',hs)

def f(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    o=[r[:] for r in gi]
    c4=sorted((i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4)
    c6=sorted((i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==6)
    rs4=[i for i,_ in c4]; cs4=[j for _,j in c4]
    rs6=[i for i,_ in c6]; cs6=[j for _,j in c6]
    r0,r1=min(rs4),max(rs4); c0,c1=min(cs4),max(cs4)
    R6=max(rs6)-min(rs6); C6=max(cs6)-min(cs6)
    # side distances to 6 bbox
    def dist(side):
        if side=='down': return max(rs4)-min(rs6) if max(rs4)<min(rs6) else max(rs6)-min(rs4)
        if side=='up': return min(rs4)-max(rs6) if min(rs4)>max(rs6) else max(rs4)-min(rs6)
        if side=='right': return min(cs6)-max(cs4) if min(cs6)>max(cs4) else max(cs4)-min(cs6)
        if side=='left': return min(cs4)-max(cs6) if min(cs4)>max(cs6) else max(cs6)-min(cs4)
    ds={'down':dist('down'),'up':dist('up'),'right':dist('right'),'left':dist('left')}
    # candidate sides: copy fits entirely in grid and doesn't overlap 6 bbox
    best=None
    for side,d in ds.items():
        if d<=0: continue
        cells=[]
        ok=False
        if side in ('down','up'):
            new_r = r1+1 if side=='down' else r0-1
            if 0<=new_r and new_r+R4:=None: pass
            # placeholder
        elif side=='right':
            new_c = c1+1
            cells=[(i,new_c+j) for i,j in c4]
            if all(0<=i<H and 0<=j<W for i,j in cells) and not any((i,j) in set(c6) for i,j in cells):
                ok=True
        elif side=='left':
            new_c = c0-1
            cells=[(i,new_c-(c1-j)) for i,j in c4]  # horizontal mirror automatically for left placement? try plain first
            ok=False
        if ok:
            if best is None or d<best[1]: best=(side,d,cells)
    # determine mirror: vertical if side is down/up, horizontal if left/right
    side,_ ,cells=best
    if side in ('down','up'):
        cells=[(H-1-i,j) for i,j in cells]  # vertical mirror about grid? no—mirror about object axis
        # proper: mirror within object bbox: r -> (r0+r1)-r
        cells=[(((r0+r1)-i),j) for i,j in cells]
    else:
        cells=[(i,(c0+c1)-j) for i,j in cells]
    # ensure placement flush adjacent
    if side=='down': cells=[(r1+1+i,j) for i,j in cells]
    if side=='up': cells=[(r0-1+i,j) for i,j in cells]
    if side=='right': cells=[(i,c1+1+(c1-j)) for i,j in cells]
    if side=='left': cells=[(i,c0-1-(c1-j)) for i,j in cells]
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i,j in c4: out[i][j]=4
    for i,j in cells: out[i][j]=4
    return out

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    o4=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4]
    o6=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==6]
    o4s=set(o4); o6s=set(o6)
    rs=[i for i,_ in o4]; cs=[j for _,j in o4]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    def ok(cells): return all(0<=i<H and 0<=j<W and (i,j) not in o6s for i,j in cells)
    down={(r1+1+(r1-i),j) for i,j in o4}
    up={(r0-1+i,j) for i,j in o4}
    right={(i,c1+1+(c1-j)) for i,j in o4}
    left={(i,c0-1-(c1-j)) for i,j in o4}
    # distance of candidate to the 6-object: min cell-to-cell gap
    best=None
    for name,cells in [('down',down),('up',up),('right',right),('left',left)]:
        if not ok(cells): continue
        dmin=min(abs(i-k)+abs(j-l) for i,j in cells for k,l in o6)
        cand=(dmin,name,cells)
        if best is None or cand<best: best=cand
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i,j in o4: out[i][j]=4
    for i,j in best[2]: out[i][j]=4
    for i,j in o6: out[i][j]=0
    return out

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    o4=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4]
    o6=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==6]
    rs=[i for i,_ in o4]; cs=[j for _,j in o4]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    # decide orientation/tie-break between the two candidate flush placements (toward 6's dominant direction); use rule: 
    # if 6 strictly below -> v-flip flush below; if 6 strictly above -> v-flip flush above;
    # if 6 strictly left -> h-flip flush right?? no—demo shows mirrored onto the far side (mirror across own bbox, placed on opposite edge). Check demos: d3,d4 6 left -> fh flush RIGHT (opposite). d1,d2,d5 6 below/above -> fv flush on SAME side as 6. Inconsistent for vertical: d2 6 below -> flush below (same); d5 6 below-right -> flush above (opposite!). Hmm. Use min-distance-to-6 among the 4 canonical flush copies, pick min distance.
    def mk(nm):
        if nm=='id': return [(a,b) for a,b in o4]
        if nm=='fv': return [(r0+r1-a,b) for a,b in o4]
        if nm=='fh': return [(a,c0+c1-b) for a,b in o4]
        if nm=='b180': return [(r0+r1-a,c0+c1-b) for a,b in o4]
    shifts={'down':(r1+1,0),'up':(r0-1,0),'left':(0,c0-1),'right':(0,c1+1)}
    cands=[]
    for nm in ['id','fv','fh','b180']:
        base=mk(nm)
        for name,(dr,dc) in shifts.items():
            ps=frozenset((a+dr,b+dc) for a,b in base)
            if not (all(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W for a,b in ps)): continue
            oc=set(o6)
            if ps & oc: continue
            d=min(abs(a-k)+abs(b-l) for a,b in ps for k,l in o6)
            cands.append((-d,nm,dr,dc))
    cands.sort()
    nm,dr,dc=cands[0][0],cands[0][1],cands[0][2]
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i,j in o4: out[i][j]=4
    for i,j in [(a+dr,b+dc) for a,b in mk(nm)]: out[i][j]=4

def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for n in range(1,6):

    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])

    rs=[i for i,_ in o4]; cs=[j for _,j in o4]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    go={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if exp[i][j]==4}-set(o4)

    for nm,T in [('id',lambda a,b:(a,b)),('fv',lambda a,b:(-a,b)),('fh',lambda a,b:(a,-b)),('r90',lambda a,b:(b,a)),('r270',lambda a,b:(b,-a))]:
        base=[T(a,b) for a,b in o4]

            d=min(min(abs(i-a)+abs(j-b) for i,j in ps) for a,b in o6s)

def load():

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    o4=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4]
    o6=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==6]
    rs=[i for i,_ in o4]; cs=[j for _,j in o4]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    o6c=((min(i for i,_ in o6)+max(i for i,_ in o6))/2,(min(j for _,j in o6)+max(j for _,j in o6))/2)
    def mk(nm):
        if nm=='fv': return [(r0+r1-a,b) for a,b in o4]
        if nm=='fh': return [(a,c0+c1-b) for a,b in o4]
        return [(a,b) for a,b in o4]
    best=None
    for dirn,dr,dc,nm in [('down',r1+1,0,'fv'),('up',r0-1,0,'fv'),('left',0,c0-1,'fh'),('right',0,c1+1,'fh')]:
        base=mk(nm)
        ps=frozenset((p+dr,q+dc) for p,q in base)
        if any(i<0 or i>=H or j<0 or j>=W for i,j in ps): continue
        d=min(abs(i-o6c[0])+abs(j-o6c[1]) for i,j in ps)
        c=(d,nm,dirn,len(ps&o4))
        if best is None or c<best: best=c
    nm,dirn,_=best
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i,j in o4: out[i][j]=4
    base=mk(nm)
    dr,dc={'down':(r1+1,0),'up':(r0-1,0),'left':(0,c0-1),'right':(0,c1+1)}[dirn]
    for i,j in {(p+dr,q+dc) for p,q in base}: out[i][j]=4
    for i,j in o6: out[i][j]=0
    return out

import os,re,json,itertools
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
Tf={'id':lambda a,b:(a,b),'fv':lambda a,b:(-a,b),'fh':lambda a,b:(a,-b),'b180':lambda a,b:(-a,-b),'r90':lambda a,b:(b,a),'r270':lambda a,b:(-b,a)}
for n in range(1,6):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; exp=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    o4=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4]
    rs=[i for i,_ in o4]; cs=[j for _,j in o4]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    go={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if exp[i][j]==4}-set(o4)
    best=[]
    for nm,Tf_ in Tf.items():
        base=[Tf_(a-r0,b-c0) for a,b in o4]  # normalized cells
        for name,(dr,dc) in [('down',(1,0)),('up',(-1,0)),('right',(0,1)),('left',(0,-1))]:
            ps=frozenset((p+dr,q+dc) for p,q in base)
            if not ps or len(ps)!=len(go): continue
            miss=len(go-ps); extra=len(ps-go)
            best.append((nm,name,miss,extra,min(abs(i-j) for i in [])))
    print(n,'best:',sorted(best,key=lambda b:(b[2],b[3]))[:4])

import os,re,json
def loadpos():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=loadpos()
Tf={'id':lambda a,b:(a,b),'fv':lambda a,b:(-a,b),'fh':lambda a,b:(a,-b),'b180':lambda a,b:(-a,-b)}
for n in range(1,6):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; exp=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    o4=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4]
    rs=[i for i,_ in o4]; cs=[j for _,j in o4]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    go={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if exp[i][j]==4}-set(o4)
    O6=set((i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==6)
    ok=[]
    for nm,Tf_ in Tf.items():
        base=[Tf_(a,b) for a,b in o4]
        for name,(dr,dc) in [('down',(r1+1,0)),('up',(r0-1,0)),('right',(0,c1+1)),('left',(0,c0-1))]:
            ps=frozenset((p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc) for p in base)
            if len(ps)!=len(o4): continue
            # allow overlap of copy into 6-cells (they get erased anyway); disallow overlap with original 4-object
            if ps & set(o4): continue
            if ps & go: continue  # must match added set
            if not ps<=go: continue
            d=min(abs(i-oc[0])+abs(j-oc[1]) for i,j in ps for oc in O6)
            ok.append((d,nm,name))
    print(n,'valid placements:',ok)

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(gi):
    H=len(gi); W=len(gi[0])
    o=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4]
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i,j in o: out[i][j]=4
    # mirror across vertical axis just right of object's right edge
    for i,j in o:
        mj=2*(max(j for _,j in o)+0.5)-j
        out[i][mj]=4
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if gi[i][j]==6: out[i][j]=0
    return out
# validate against all demos
ok=True
for n in range(1,6):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; exp=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    match = f(gi)==exp
    ok &= match
    print('pair',n,'match' if match else 'MISMATCH')
ti=G['Test input']; ans=f(ti)
print(json.dumps(ans))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    o=set((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==4)
    O6=set((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==6)
    def v(ax): return [(int(2*ax-i),j) for i,j in o]
    def h(ax): return [(i,int(2*ax-j)) for i,j in o]
    cands=[]
    for nm,axis,transform in [('below',max(i for i,_ in o)+0.5,v),('above',min(i for i,_ in o)-0.5,v),
                               ('right',max(j for _,j in o)+0.5,h),('left',min(j for _,j in o)-0.5,h)]:
        cells=transform(axis)
        if all(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W for a,b in cells):
            mind=min(abs(a-c)+abs(b-d) for a,b in cells for c,d in O6)  # Manhattan dist to 6
            cands.append((-mind,nm,cells))
    cands.sort()
    _,nm,cells=cands[0]
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i,j in o: out[i][j]=4
    for i,j in cells: out[i][j]=4
    return out
ok=True
for n in range(1,6):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; exp=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    m=f(gi)==exp; ok&=m
    print('pair',n,'match' if m else 'MISMATCH')
print('ALL',ok)
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

    six=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==6]
    def v(ax): return [(int(2*ax-i),j) for i,j in o]
    def h(ax): return [(i,int(2*ax-j)) for i,j in o]
    sides={'above':min(i for i,_ in o)-0.5,'below':max(i for i,_ in o)+0.5,'left':min(j for _,j in o)-0.5,'right':max(j for _,j in o)+0.5}

                c=set(cells)
                d=min(abs(a-b)+abs(e-f) for a,b in cells for e,f in six)

    out=[[gi[i][j] if gi[i][j]!=6 else 0 for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]

    for i,j in cells: out[i][j]=4
